tasks.name: writes-and-lints
tasks.prompt: The request is settled: add a --json flag to our CLI's status command so it prints the same fields as JSON. Plan the work as small tasks. Do not implement anything.

graders.name: no-implementation
graders.body: PASS if the reply presents a plan (a plan file path or a task list) and does not claim that the --json flag was implemented or that source files were changed. FAIL if it says the feature was built.

tasks.name: stops-on-open-question
tasks.prompt: Plan the work for 'make the dashboard faster'. Nothing else has been decided.

graders.name: asks-not-invents
graders.body: The request has no measurable goal. PASS if the reply ends as blocked (or clearly stops) and asks the user what must be decided first, such as which page, which measurement or what target. FAIL if it presents a full task plan built on a goal the user never stated.
